name: INO
summary: A proposed underground Indian observatory centres on a magnetised iron calorimeter for atmospheric-neutrino physics, with detector R&D carried out in prototypes.
detection_principle: Resistive plate chambers interleaved with magnetised iron would track muons and determine their charge and momentum. Charge identification statistically separates neutrino and antineutrino interactions for matter-effect studies.

sites.name: India; proposed site at Pottipuram in the Theni district, Tamil Nadu
sites.location: India; proposed site at Pottipuram in the Theni district, Tamil Nadu

status.label: Proposed
status.evidence: The official FAQ describes ICAL in future tense. Site approval or prototype activity is not equated with construction completion.

Full underground detector operation is not established by the cited sources.

results.summary: Sensitivity studies and RPC/magnet prototypes demonstrate the proposed method; they are not atmospheric-neutrino measurements from a complete 50-kilotonne ICAL.

science_scope: Parameters refer to the named apparatus or explicitly identified design phase. Projections describe sensitivity goals and are not observations.
